commits.message:
perf: resolve soroban_sdk type paths without string allocation

Replace the string-based match_soroban_def_path implementation
(cx.tcx.def_path_str + segments.join + ends_with) with a direct
call to clippy_utils::match_def_path, which walks the canonical
definition path lazily segment by segment without any allocation.

This eliminates two String allocations per method-call expression
in all six lint passes, while maintaining correct re-export
handling since re-exports share the same DefId as the original
definition.

Closes #134

fix: use def_path_str cache instead of unavailable clippy_utils::match_def_path

clippy_utils::match_def_path is not available in the pinned
clippy_utils version (f6d3106). Replace the call with a
thread_local def_path_str cache that ensures each unique DefId
only gets its full path formatted once, achieving the same
perf benefit.
Merge upstream/main to sync UI test fixtures

fix: add missing storage_write_without_read warning to UI stderr fixture

The batch_write_different_keys test fixture at line 184 triggers
the storage_write_without_read lint but the expected stderr was
missing this warning. Updated warning count from 27 to 28.

fix: correct all line numbers in UI stderr after upstream merge

Upstream added new test fixtures (batch_write_different_keys,
good_env_ref_clone, good_env_used_after_clone, etc.) that shifted
all diagnostic line numbers. Regenerated main.stderr to match
the actual compiler output exactly.
